ParseBytes and its strictly necessary byte-size constants/table from github.com/dustin/go-humanize.

This is an individually licensed generic quantity parser, not Loki telemetry/parser/evaluator code.
Only the selected function/table/constants are included; no upstream tests or unrelated humanize helpers are included.
Exact pinned vendor source URLs, original/extracted/adapted SHA-256 and all adaptations are in provenance.json.
